d:
The Nuggets defeated the Celtics, 105-101 tonight in Denver. Nikola Jokić contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 9 assists 8 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Jamal Murray of the Nuggets adding an additional 21 points (7-15 FG, 2-6 3P) in the game. Jayson Tatum finished with a team-high 24 points along with 8 rebounds for the Celtics in the losing effort. The Nuggets improve their record to 8-5 with the win, while the Celtics fall to 11-4 for the season.
